d: The sixteenth letter of the Spanish alphabet, called o and written in the Latin script.
Used with a stem to form a masculine singular noun.
suffix indicating the first-person singular present indicative of verbs
suffix indicating the third-person singular preterite indicative of most irregular verbs
superseded spelling of o when between numerals, deprecated in 2010 by the Royal Spanish Academy
A letter of the Latin alphabet representing an accented vowel /o/; capital form of ó
a suffix indicating the third-person singular indicative preterite of a verb in -ar
